title: An exclusion whose reference matches no dimension is rejected by the engine when the interaction is added, not by the SDK.
why: behavioural spec 'exclude': the SDK checks nothing about an exclusion. The engine resolves its references when the interaction is added (ADR 0080 decision 3), so a reference that matches no dimension fails 'execute' with 'interaction-invalid' before any variant runs.

interaction.description: an exclusion on a field the shape does not have

exclude.reason: an order is never delivered in a test
